blocks.html: Davao City, Philippines (August 2024) - It was a full-packed yet highly successful weekend for RLC Residences as the real estate developer and Sunrise Events, a part of IRONMAN Group, hosted the Davao leg of IRONKIDS 2024 while their IRONMAN female relay team became a podium finisher of IRONMAN 70.3.

blocks.cap: The RLC Residences IRONKIDS team during the duathlon race at Davao City

blocks.html: More than just a competition, RLC Residences IRONKIDS Davao is also a celebration of young talent, determination, and sportsmanship. Held on the picturesque coast of Davao, the event brought together almost 300 young athletes aged 6 to 14, all eager to test their mettle in a series of run-bike-run challenges. For many participants, IRONKIDS is their first taste of competitive sports, making it a critical stepping stone in their athletic journey.

“Witnessing the children’s perseverance and sportsmanship at an early age are two of the many things we love about IRONKIDS. We are grateful to have this opportunity because it inspires us to continuously support young athletes like them in their quest to become great in their chosen sport,” shares Karen Cesario, RLC Residences Marketing Head and Chief Integration Officer.

Prior to the day of the event, RLC Residences hosted a special family affair with the kids and their parents in attendance, including the brand’s IRONKIDS team who happily participated in the different activities. Cesario also shared that one of the kids is currently preparing to try out for the upcoming SEA Games for his age group.

“When we learn about stories like these, it makes us more motivated to extend whatever support we can give these kids. We wish to help them achieve these goals and sincerely hope that they qualify. But overall, what we really aim for is to be with them as they start this journey and help them win in life,” says Cesario.
RLC Residences Triathlon Team in IRONMAN Davao 70.3

blocks.cap: Alessandra Silerio, Maicee Quejada, and Tricia Cruz from RLC Residences Triathlon Team are podium finishers in the all-female relay at IRONMAN Davao 2024.

blocks.html: In addition to RLC Residences IRONKIDS Davao, the brand also had a personal stake in the prestigious IRONMAN Davao, with one of their own athletes securing a remarkable 3rd place podium finish. Composed of Alessandra Silerio, Maicee Quejada, and Tricia Cruz, the power trio finished the entire swim-bike-run course in a span of 5 hours and 18 minutes.
The rest of the team, who also competed in both individual and relays, successfully finished the race and reached the finish line.

“Racing for IRONMAN 70.3 is no easy feat, that’s why I’m always proud of the team for continuously breaking records for all of us. This is the first time that our all-female relay unit made it to podium finish since we established the team in 2022, and I’m thankful to them for this historic win,” says Dan Carlo Torres, RLC Residences’ Brand Management and Operations Head and Team Lead of the brand’s triathlon team. Torres also competed in the race and finished the course in 5 hours and 45 minutes.

The IRONMAN Davao is known for its grueling course, which challenges even the most seasoned athletes. Competing against some of the best in the world, RLC Residences’ representatives showcased not only physical endurance but also the mental toughness required to excel in such a demanding event.

RLC Residences has been a staunch supporter of IRONMAN and IRONKIDS, and their involvement in both races is part of a broader strategy for community building and celebration of wellness and sportsmanship. The brand believes that supporting events like this serves as a reminder that with determination, dedication, and a supportive community, anything is possible for aspiring athletes.
